name: Aitō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aitō town emblem in green: a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Flag of the former town of Aitō in Shiga Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 1971.

features.role: Aitō town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised letter V
